title: SIWES & NYSC Internship Support
description: SoftCodeMath Academy runs a structured SIWES and NYSC support program that helps university students and corps members secure meaningful placements and gain workplace skills. For SIWES (2nd/3rd year industrial training) we provide pre-placement preparation (CV & portfolio reviews, technical briefings, interview simulations), placement matching with partner companies, project templates aligned to university learning outcomes, and ongoing mentorship with weekly check-ins and assessment reports. For NYSC participants we offer supervised community-tech projects, short-term placements, micro-contracts, and certification pathways to help graduates build marketable portfolios during their service year. The program is flexible across technologies—students learn tools and stacks relevant to their placement and career goals, with emphasis on practical deliverables, professional communication, and employability.
technologies: Flexible (supports any technology — tailored to student and host needs)
